competing_interpretations.interpretation: A universal EUR 10 blocking threshold conflicts with any supplier-specific increase.
The overseas-supplier adjustment is an extra detail not explicitly addressed by the text.
Applying a threshold separately to each request does not by itself specify the order-creation or merge mechanism.
Automatic merging changes the unit of assessment and conflicts with the separate-request rule.
The mandatory correction request conflicts with an express statement that asking is optional; the unspecified portal is an additional detail.
The compound statement adds a portal-specific duty absent from the source; annotation should first split its obligation and channel components.
